objective: Take up sub-goal B60 (G15 with G4 and G1) at the coordinator's go-ahead of 2026-11-10: a knot sphere's forced dissonance cannot be resolved, a torus's class-forced one can, only by winding. Grow a handle by splicing a Fano atom (the Fano plane less a point, uniform signs) at a line of the knot sphere, at the dissonance or away from it, and read whether the grown law is still forced, whether learning then resolves it by winding through the new handle, and what placement changes. A builder from rotation systems to knot spaces is made and checked first. Expectations pre-registered in research/GROW-HANDLE-20261110-001/preregistration.md.
stop_rule: Stop when every grown sphere tried is read (forced or not, resolved by learning or not, cost by placement), or at the first grown space learning cannot resolve.
title: Learning that grows a handle
